summary: GRN Fase 3 verified end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest pass (22 Fase 1+2 regression + 6 new Fase 3 endpoint tests in test_grn_phase3_endpoints.py — partners for supplier & makloon, supplier-variance for admin AND warehouse (via goods_receipt.view), rolls 404 on bogus id, route ordering /partners & /supplier-variance NOT captured by /{grn_id}). Frontend E2E as admin@ ent_ksc: (1) ?view=goods-receipts loads Kedatangan / Selisih Supplier tabs (grn-view-tab-list, grn-view-tab-variance) + grn-new-button. (2) Wizard flow: grn-new-button → grn-wizard opens Langkah 1 dari 2 with grn-wizard-type-supplier|makloon, grn-wizard-partner KNSelect showing 5 supplier options with 'N PO terbuka' hint. Selected Cirebon Craft (2 PO terbuka) → grn-wizard-docs chips rendered (grn-wizard-doc-<po_id> for KSC/PO-00014 & KSC/PO-00013). Warehouse auto-preset to 'Gudang Jakarta Utara' from first open_doc. grn-wizard-next → step 2 (photo upload optional, skipped) → grn-wizard-submit → created KSC/GRN-00001 with status Draf, GrnDetail shows grn-stepper (Draf → Tinjau SJ → Hitung fisik → Rekonsiliasi → Ditutup), tabs grn-tab-review|count|recon, grn-review-panel, grn-photo-empty, grn-manual-entry, grn-cancel. (3) grn-manual-entry → grn-dn-form fields grn-dn-number/date/supplier-printed/recipient/po-refs/plate + grn-dn-save. Filled TEST_SJ-276433 → save → status advanced to Tinjau SJ (2), line-add form appeared with Kode/Deskripsi/PO/Qty/Satuan/Roll/Kg/Bruto-Netto/Grade/Lot/Non-stok + Target KNSelect + Baris button + 'Mulai hitung fisik'/Tolak buttons. (4) PO integration: ?view=purchase-orders → KSC/PO-00014 detail shows receive-goods-button ('Terima Barang di Gudang') AND receive-goods-legacy-button ('Barang Masuk (lama)'). Click receive-goods-button navigates to ?view=goods-receipts with grn-wizard preset — Cirebon Craft partner, both PO chips (KSC/PO-00014 highlighted), Gudang Jakarta Utara warehouse preset. Preset works exactly per spec. (5) Selisih Supplier tab (grn-view-tab-variance): loads grn-variance-panel with range chips grn-variance-range-90|180|365|all + grn-variance-table + grn-variance-empty (no closed GRNs yet — expected). (6) Warehouse@ view: after warehouse login → ?view=goods-receipts loads with same tab structure, grn-new-button PRESENT (has create perm), grn-view-tab-variance PRESENT (has view perm). ?view=operations → Barang Masuk shows 19 inbound-task-* cards, task panel opens fine (SKU/supplier/scan-label input renders); no inbound-grn-banner (no active GRN counting a task — correct). Cleanup: cancelled the 1 test GRN via grn-cancel + confirm-modal (testids confirm-modal-reason + confirm-modal-confirm) → status Dibatalkan. No residue closed GRN created (kept receiving.mode legacy, no stock posted).
action_items: Minor doc drift only: the request spec calls the reason dialog 'askReason dialog' but the actual DOM testids are confirm-modal / confirm-modal-reason / confirm-modal-confirm (used by grn-cancel). Consider aligning either the spec wording or exposing a stable alias like ask-reason-* for consistency with the rest of the codebase.

Not tested end-to-end (out of scope for time budget & to avoid stock-posting side effects): Hitung-tab scan flow (grn-count-scan-1, undo, grn-finish-count), Rekonsiliasi discrepancy resolve (grn-disc-<key>-<action>), grn-close, blind-count UI for warehouse@ opening an in-review GRN (grn-blind-note), and old-inbound-panel inbound-grn-banner while a GRN is actively counting. Backend behaviour for these is already covered by test_grn_phase2.py (blind_count contract test + partial delivery / discrepancies test + GRN_MODE guard). Recommend main-agent self-test or a dedicated follow-up iteration for these UI paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in /app/backend/routers/goods_receipts.py is correct: /goods-receipts/partners and /goods-receipts/supplier-variance are registered BEFORE /goods-receipts/{grn_id} so path routing won't mis-match — verified by test_route_ordering_partners_not_treated_as_id.
supplier-variance uses require_any_permission([(goods_receipt,view),(purchase_order,view)]) — verified warehouse@ (has goods_receipt.view) receives 200 not 403.

GrnCreateWizard.jsx auto-presets whId from partner.open_docs[0].warehouse_id (line 25) which is exactly what makes the 'Terima Barang di Gudang' PO shortcut land users on a ready-to-submit wizard — verified in UI test.

Wizard preset (partner_id + po_ids + warehouse_id) via location state is propagated correctly from PODetail → GoodsReceiptsView → GrnCreateWizard — the PO chip was highlighted (docIds prefilled from preset.po_ids) and partner select showed the preselected supplier.

Warehouse role legitimately sees grn-new-button and grn-view-tab-variance because they hold goods_receipt.create and goods_receipt.view. If the intent was to hide variance from warehouse (per some interpretations), reconsider the permission mapping; per current spec it is INTENDED (view perm is enough).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested surface — wizard create, DN save, tabs, PO shortcut, variance panel, warehouse role access, inbound task panel; deep count/close flow deferred
